headline: The War of the Worlds hits the airwaves
post_facts: Orson Welles, 23, staged it on CBS
About 2% of people surveyed were listening
Historians call the mass panic overblown

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen thirty-eight... Martians invaded New Jersey. On the radio.

scenes.label: Orson Welles, 1938
scenes.caption: Welles at the radio microphone
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Twenty-three-year-old Orson Welles staged The War of the Worlds on CBS, as fake news bulletins.

scenes.label: of people surveyed tuned in
scenes.text: [calmly] Newspapers said the nation panicked. But a survey found only about two percent were listening.

scenes.title: A panic made by newspapers?
scenes.text: [softly] Some were frightened... but historians say the mass panic was mostly a newspaper story.
